heading: Progress reports
lead: The President shall include as a part of the annual report required under section 2291h of title 22 an evaluation of progress that each major drug producing country and each major drug-transit country has made during the reporting period in achieving the objectives set forth in section 2492(b) of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1999—Pub. L. 106–36 substituted “section 2291h of title 22” for “section 2291(e)(1) of title 22”.
